title: A.M. Best Assigns Issue Credit Rating to Fidelity & Guaranty Life Holdings, Inc.’s Senior Unsecured Notes
text: A.M. Best Assigns Issue Credit Rating to Fidelity & Guaranty Life Holdings, Inc.’s Senior Unsecured Notes Friday, 20 April 2018 ( 13 minutes ago ) OLDWICK, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--A.M. Best has assigned a Long-Term Issue Credit Rating (Long-Term IR) of “bb+” to the $550 million 5.5% senior unsecured notes due 2025 issued by Fidelity & Guaranty Life Holdings, Inc. (FGLH) (Delaware). The outlook assigned to the Credit Rating (rating) is positive. FGLH’s Long-Term Issuer Credit Rating of “bb+” with a positive outlook and the Credit Ratings of its operating insurance subsidiaries are unchanged.
